title: Natchez Balloon Race

services.name: Balloon Race
services.desc: Join us for the 41st annual Natchez Balloon Festival on October 16-17, 2026. Mirroring the lengthy history of the city, festival grounds are located at Rosalie Mansion's high bluffs above the Mississippi River. Live, world-class musical entertainment keeps feet moving while hot air balloons drift silently overhead. In addition to the breathtaking location, a carnival and Arts and Crafts market make the Natchez Balloon Festival one of the most family-friendly events in the state.
